name: Uchino Manae
source:
Mother-in-law. A good wife and an intelligent mother.
Her only child is her daughter, Konami.
She possesses strong will but when it comes to her own matters, she becomes reserved and tends to be a pushover.
Since there was an age gap of twelve years between her and her husband, they eloped and were blessed with their daughter.
She hasn't been with any man other than her husband and also doesn't have much experience in sex. 

[Translated from [url=https://www.appetite-game.com/apadash/aptd_021.html#char]Official website[/url]]
